test_title: PYST 4: SSC GD Constable 2022 - English (Held On : 10 Jan 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
The sentence given below has one misspelt word. Spot the INCORRECTLY spelt word and select its correct spelling.

He wishes to be an orthopidic surgeon.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3'** i.e. **'Orthopaedic'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The incorrectly spelled word in the sentence is** "orthopidic".**
 
• The correct spelling is 3) **"Orthopaedic".**
 
• **"Orthopaedic"** is an adjective that pertains to the branch of medicine dealing with the correction of deformities of bones or muscles.
 
• This specialized branch of medicine is related to conditions involving the musculoskeletal system and requires specialized medical training to practice
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**** Orthopaedics** is the preferred spelling in British English, while American English 'orthopedics' is correct. 

Therefore, the **correct answer **is: **'Orthopaedic'.**
